noProject: Open this page from a project's workspace: it needs the project.
projectUnreadable: The project is not readable with your access; what you may do is decided when you act.
notEditable: This record can no longer be changed: only a draft or a returned record is edited.
notRaiser: Only the project's Project Manager raises this request; if you are not, the request will be refused.
returnedNote: It was returned for correction. Submitting it again sends it as revision {revision}.

withdraw.title: Withdraw request
withdraw.consequence: Withdrawing ends this request before its review; it cannot be submitted again. A new request can be raised afterwards.

startReview.title: Start review
startReview.consequence: Starting the review sends this revision to its approvers through the approval workflow. Its fields can no longer be changed unless it is returned.

delete.title: Delete draft
delete.consequence: Deleting removes this draft permanently. It was never submitted, so nothing else changes.

done.reviewStarted: Review started. The approvers find it in their inbox.
done.activated: Activated: the project's lifecycle has changed.
done.approve: Your approval is recorded. The record shows Approved once every stage of its route has approved and the outcome reaches it.
done.return: Your return is recorded. The record shows Returned once the outcome reaches it.
done.reject: Your rejection is recorded. The record shows Rejected once the outcome reaches it.

review.title: Review
review.unreadable: The review's history is not readable with your access.
review.youDecide: Your inbox holds the decision on this revision.

SUSPENDED.title: This project is suspended
SUSPENDED.body: Work is on hold until an approved resumption takes effect.

COMPLETED.title: This project is completed
COMPLETED.body: Stage 1 of the closeout is done. Stage 2, Closure, follows once every post-project obligation is settled.

CLOSED.title: Closed: read-only
CLOSED.body: This project is closed. Its records are kept as history; nothing in any tab can be changed.
CLOSED.bodyDated: This project was closed on {date}. Its records are kept as history; nothing in any tab can be changed.

suspension.title: Suspension requests
suspension.description: The suspension and resumption requests of the projects you can see, most recently changed first. A project's Project Manager raises them from the project's Suspension tab.
suspension.caption: Suspension and resumption requests across projects
suspension.projectCaption: The project's suspension and resumption requests
suspension.forbidden: Your access does not include this project's suspension requests.
suspension.emptyProject: Requests the project's Project Manager raises to suspend or resume the project appear here.
suspension.emptyAcross: None of the projects you can see has a suspension or resumption request.
suspension.periodsCaption: The project's suspension periods, most recent first
suspension.noPeriods: The project has never been suspended.
suspension.plannedOnly: Planning information only: nothing resumes on this date

typeHint.SUSPEND: A suspension puts an active project on hold. A resumption is requested separately while it is suspended.
typeHint.RESUME: A resumption returns a suspended project to active. Its approved baseline is not changed.

form.effectiveHint: Required to submit, from today on (UTC). The project changes state on this date, once the request is approved.
form.plannedHint: Optional, after the effective date. For planning only: the project resumes only through an approved resumption request.

submitNote.SUSPEND: Approval does not suspend the project by itself: it is suspended when the approved request takes effect on its effective date.
submitNote.RESUME: Approval does not resume the project by itself: it becomes active again when the approved request takes effect on its effective date. No new baseline is created.

command.activateConsequence: Activating applies the approved request now, if its effective date has come: the project's lifecycle changes. The activation pass does this on its own; use this to apply it at once or to retry one left approved.

SUSPEND.DRAFT: A draft. Nothing is decided and the project is unchanged.
SUSPEND.SUBMITTED: Submitted and waiting for AHDA to start the review. The project is unchanged.
SUSPEND.UNDER_REVIEW: In review through the approval workflow. The project is unchanged.
SUSPEND.RETURNED: Returned for correction. Correct it and submit it again as the next revision.
SUSPEND.APPROVED: Approved, not yet in effect. The project stays active until the request is activated on its effective date.
SUSPEND.REJECTED: Rejected. The project was not suspended.
SUSPEND.WITHDRAWN: Withdrawn. The project was not suspended.
SUSPEND.EFFECTED: In effect: the project was suspended when this request was activated.

RESUME.DRAFT: A draft. Nothing is decided and the project stays suspended.
RESUME.SUBMITTED: Submitted and waiting for AHDA to start the review. The project stays suspended.
RESUME.UNDER_REVIEW: In review through the approval workflow. The project stays suspended.
RESUME.RETURNED: Returned for correction. Correct it and submit it again as the next revision.
RESUME.APPROVED: Approved, not yet in effect. The project stays suspended until the request is activated on its effective date.
RESUME.EFFECTED: In effect: the project became active again when this request was activated. Its approved baseline was not changed.

resumption.title: Resumption
resumption.underWay: A resumption request is under way.
resumption.none: No resumption has been requested. The project's Project Manager requests one.

stages.title: Closeout stages
stages.intro: A project is closed out in two steps, one after the other: Completion ends its delivery, then Closure ends the project. Each step is its own request, reviewed and approved on its own.

completion.NOT_YET: Completion is requested once the project is active.
completion.LOCKED: Completion is requested once the project is active.
completion.READY: The project's Project Manager raises the completion request when delivery has ended. Full progress or every task done does not complete the project by itself.
completion.IN_PROGRESS: The completion request is open. The project becomes completed only when the approved request is activated.
completion.DONE: The project is completed: its delivery has ended.
completion.ON_HOLD: The project is suspended. It is resumed before it is completed, or closed without completion in Stage 2.
completion.SKIPPED: The project is closed from suspension without being completed.

closure.LOCKED: Closure starts after Stage 1, Completion, has taken effect.
closure.READY: The project's Project Manager raises the closure request once every post-project obligation is settled.
closure.IN_PROGRESS: The closure request is open. The project closes only when the approved request is activated.
closure.DONE: The project is closed: terminal and read-only.
closure.TERMINAL_READY: The project is suspended: it can be closed without completion. Its suspension ends when the closure takes effect.
closure.TERMINAL_IN_PROGRESS: The closure without completion is open. The project closes, and its suspension ends, only when the approved request is activated.

closeout.title: Closure requests
closeout.description: The completion and closure requests of the projects you can see, each naming its stage, most recently changed first. A project's Project Manager raises them from the project's Closeout tab.
closeout.caption: Completion and closure requests across projects
closeout.projectCaption: The project's completion and closure requests
closeout.forbidden: Your access does not include this project's closeout.
closeout.emptyProject: The completion and closure requests of this project appear here.
closeout.emptyAcross: None of the projects you can see has a completion or closure request.

intro.completion: Stage 1 of 2. Completion records that the project's delivery has ended; the project becomes completed when the approved request takes effect. Closure is a separate request, raised afterwards.
intro.closure: Stage 2 of 2. Closure ends the completed project; once it takes effect the project is terminal and read-only.
intro.terminal: Stage 2 of 2, without Stage 1. The project is suspended and will not resume: closing it ends its suspension, and it is recorded as closed without completion.

form.completionDateHint: The date the works actually finished: required to submit, not after today and not before the project was activated. It changes no schedule date.

narrativeHint.completion: Required to submit: what was delivered and how the project ended.
narrativeHint.closure: Required to submit: how the project was closed out.

form.nextStep: Saving keeps it as a draft. Its readiness is evaluated and it is submitted from its own page.

command.submitConsequence: Submitting evaluates the readiness again and sends the request for review if no criterion fails without a waiver. Its fields can then no longer be changed unless it is returned.
command.activateConsequence: Activating evaluates the readiness again and, if nothing blocks it, changes the project's lifecycle now. The activation pass does this on its own; use this to apply it at once or to retry one left approved.
command.deleteConsequence: Deleting removes this draft permanently. A draft with readiness records or obligations is withdrawn instead.

completion.DRAFT: A draft. Evaluate its readiness, then submit it. The project stays active.
completion.SUBMITTED: Submitted and waiting for AHDA to start the review. The project stays active.
completion.UNDER_REVIEW: In review through the approval workflow. The project stays active.
completion.RETURNED: Returned for correction. Correct it and submit it again as the next revision.
completion.APPROVED: Approved, not yet in effect. The project stays active until the request is activated; its readiness is checked again first.
completion.EFFECTED: In effect: the project is completed. Stage 2, Closure, can now be requested.

closure.DRAFT: A draft. Evaluate its readiness, then submit it. The project is unchanged.
closure.SUBMITTED: Submitted and waiting for AHDA to start the review. The project is unchanged.
closure.UNDER_REVIEW: In review through the approval workflow. The project is unchanged.
closure.RETURNED: Returned for correction. Correct it and submit it again as the next revision.
closure.APPROVED: Approved, not yet in effect. The project is not closed until the request is activated; its readiness is checked again first.
closure.REJECTED: Rejected. The project is not closed.
closure.WITHDRAWN: Withdrawn. The project is not closed.
closure.EFFECTED: In effect: the project is closed, terminal and read-only.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.caption: Readiness criteria of the latest evaluation

explain.READY: Every criterion passed in the latest evaluation.
explain.READY_WITH_CONDITIONS: Every criterion that failed has been waived.
explain.NOT_READY: At least one criterion fails without a waiver: the request cannot be submitted or take effect until it is settled or waived.
explain.INCOMPLETE: Readiness has not been evaluated yet. It is evaluated again when the request is submitted and when it takes effect.

waive.title: Waive: {criterion}
waive.consequence: The criterion stays failed in the record, with your waiver and reason beside it. Once every failure is waived the request reads Ready with conditions.

obligations.title: Post-project obligations
obligations.intro: {open} of {total} open. Obligations may stay open after Completion; Closure waits until every one is settled.
obligations.caption: The project's post-project obligations
obligations.ownerHint: Completion needs an owner and a due date on every open obligation.

start.title: Start: {name}
start.consequence: Marks the obligation as being worked on.

satisfy.title: Satisfy: {name}
satisfy.consequence: Records the obligation as fulfilled. A settled obligation cannot be changed again.

cancel.title: Cancel: {name}
cancel.consequence: Records that the obligation no longer applies. A settled obligation cannot be changed again.

waive.title: Waive: {name}
waive.consequence: AHDA releases the project from this obligation. A settled obligation cannot be changed again.

fieldErrors.effectiveDateRequired: Enter the effective date to submit.
fieldErrors.effectiveDatePast: The effective date cannot be before today (UTC).
fieldErrors.plannedResumptionBeforeEffective: The planned resumption date must be after the effective date.
fieldErrors.completionDateRequired: Enter the actual completion date to submit.
fieldErrors.completionDateInvalid: The completion date cannot be after today or before the project was activated.

problems.suspensionProjectNotEligible: The project is not in a state this request applies to: a suspension is of an active project, a resumption of a suspended one.
problems.suspensionAlreadyExists: The project is already suspended, or already has an open suspension request.
problems.resumptionAlreadyExists: The project already has an open resumption request.
problems.suspensionIncomplete: Enter the effective date before submitting.
problems.suspensionDateInvalid: Check the dates: the effective date cannot be in the past, and a planned resumption comes after it.
problems.notEditable: Only a draft or a returned record can be changed.
problems.underReview: It is under review: withdraw it from review instead.
problems.notYetEffective: Its effective date has not come yet; it takes effect on that date.
problems.closureProjectNotEligible: The project is not in a state this stage applies to: completion is of an active project, closure of a completed or suspended one.
problems.caseAlreadyOpen: The project already has an open request for this stage.
problems.caseInUse: This draft has readiness records or obligations: withdraw it instead of deleting it.
problems.closureIncomplete: Enter the completion date and summary, or the closure summary, before submitting.
problems.completionDateInvalid: The completion date cannot be after today or before the project was activated.
problems.blockerExists: A readiness criterion fails without a waiver.
problems.blockersNamed: These criteria fail without a waiver: {criteria}. Settle them in their registers, or have them waived where allowed.
problems.checkNotFailed: That criterion did not fail in the latest evaluation.
problems.checkNotWaivable: That criterion cannot be waived: it is settled where it lives.
problems.obligationCaseInvalid: An obligation is recorded against the project's open or completed completion request, or its open closure without completion.
problems.obligationOwnerInvalid: The owner must be an active user.
problems.projectClosed: The project is closed: it is read-only and nothing can be changed.
problems.approvalPending: A review of this revision is already in progress.
problems.configurationMissing: No approval route is configured for this request yet. AHDA must publish one before it can be reviewed.
problems.invalidTransition: That step is not possible from the record's current state.
problems.terminalState: The record is final and cannot change.
problems.permissionDenied: Your access does not allow this action.
problems.stale: It changed while you were working on it. Here is its current state.
